record.notes: The tracker's 1,024 GB and the vendor's 1 TB are the same figure in different units, so the two agree. The vendor states a 3-day money-back guarantee and accepts card, PayPal, Alipay and cryptocurrency, quoted on the page; that is a payment fact, not a trial. Unverified: the port speed, which neither page states plainly, and whether the 1 TB is calculated on outbound only. Rendering and provenance: currency symbols are written out (EUR, GBP, RUB, VND), diacritics in place names are folded to ASCII, and a price the page splits across two lines is joined as value/period; the tracker page stated 'Database update: 7 hours ago' when it was read on 2026-10-22.
